hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that implements concentrated liquidity backed by Euler lending vaults. All swap logic runs in beforeSwap: input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault, output tokens are withdrawn, and a BeforeSwapDelta is returned to bypass standard pool accounting. Each pool instance is deployed as a delegatecall proxy of a shared EulerSwap implementation.
